entities.summary: Filipp Denisovich Bobkov was a Soviet and Russian KGB functionary, who worked as the chief of the KGB subunit responsible for repressing dissent, which was responsible for suppression of internal dissent in the former Soviet Union. He was widely regarded as the chief KGB ideologist or "KGB brain."
